edges.notes: libseccomp builds seccomp BPF programs and applies them via the kernel seccomp uAPI.
Targets Linux prctl/seccomp syscalls and seccomp-filter behavior as documented for the running kernel.
libseccomp is a C library for syscall filtering policies.
Typical GNU/Linux builds link libseccomp against glibc.
musl-based Linux userlands may link libseccomp.
Clang compiles libseccomp and its consumers.
GCC compiles libseccomp and its consumers.
Container runtimes and security profiles may compose seccomp profiles on Linux nodes.
